subject: Penalized Maximum Likelihood for Factor Analysis via Non-Convex penalties

messages.author: 243eb9d15fa3db07
messages.subject: Penalized Maximum Likelihood for Factor Analysis via Non-Convex penalties
parts:
Dear Lavaan Group,

I have a problem of validating a model for my outcome of interest, where I have a lot of missing observations on a number of variables that are correlated with the outcome of interest. I believe the right approach to address this problem is to conduct a Penalized Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Factor Analysis via non-convex penalties.

I am wondering if your package Lavaan ( in R) can handle the Penalized  maximum likelihood estimation for Factor Analysis or is there another package that I need to download for validating my model. 

Thanks for the feedback.
Prabuddha Sanyal
